task: Replace the building geometry in image_1 with the 3D architecture from image_2, while preserving only the texture and color information from image_1.

geometric_source.primary: image_2 (side_view_architecture_map.png) is the ONLY source of building geometry, heights, and 3D structure.
geometric_source.constraint: COMPLETELY IGNORE and REMOVE all building structures visible in image_1. The satellite image must only serve as a texture library, not a geometric reference.
geometric_source.instruction: The final output must use the exact 3D building volumes, footprints, and heights defined in image_2. Any buildings visible in the satellite image (image_1) must be treated as obsolete and replaced.

texture_source.primary: image_1 (original_satellite_image.png) provides ONLY surface colors, materials, and textures.
texture_source.constraint: Extract texture information from image_1 without inferring or preserving any 3D structure from it.
texture_source.sampling: Sample colors and patterns from image_1's roof regions, ground surfaces, and vegetation areas to apply onto the corresponding surfaces of the 3D geometry from image_2.

scene.description: A photorealistic, oblique-view urban scene where the 3D building geometry is exclusively defined by the architecture map (image_2). The textured appearance of roofs, facades, and ground surfaces are intelligently derived from the satellite image (image_1), creating a seamless integration of accurate geometry with realistic textures.

roof_texturing.method: Project roof textures from image_1 onto the top horizontal faces of buildings defined in image_2.
roof_texturing.alignment: Match the 2D footprint positions between both images to correctly map satellite roof textures onto corresponding 3D building tops.
roof_texturing.details: Preserve realistic roof materials like tiles, metal sheeting, gravel, HVAC units, and solar panels from image_1.

facade_generation.method: Generate photorealistic building facades (walls) that match the height and shape from image_2.
facade_generation.style: Infer facade appearance (windows, materials, colors) based on: (1) building type/height from image_2, (2) overall color palette from image_1.
facade_generation.constraint: Do NOT use any facade geometry or building edges visible in image_1. All vertical surfaces must be newly generated based on image_2's 3D structure.

ground_texturing.method: Apply ground-level textures (roads, sidewalks, grass, trees) from image_1 onto the ground plane around the 3D buildings from image_2.
ground_texturing.constraint: Remove all transient objects (vehicles, people) and building shadows from image_1 before applying ground textures.

critical_rules.rule_1: The 3D structure in the final output must be 100% identical to image_2. No additional buildings from image_1 should appear.
critical_rules.rule_2: If a building exists in image_2 but not in image_1, generate appropriate generic textures for it.
critical_rules.rule_3: If a building exists in image_1 but not in image_2, it must be completely removed and replaced with ground texture.
critical_rules.rule_4: Building count, positions, and heights in the output must exactly match image_2, never image_1.

environment.lighting: Natural midday sunlight with realistic shadows cast by buildings according to their heights in image_2.
environment.atmosphere: Clear, high-visibility aerial conditions with no haze or artistic filters.
environment.colors: Natural color palette matching the authentic tones from the satellite image (image_1).

visual_style.rendering: High-detail architectural visualization with sharp edges and realistic material appearances.
visual_style.tone: Neutral, objective documentation style matching professional drone/satellite imagery.

composition.camera_angle: Oblique aerial perspective matching the viewing angle of image_2, clearly showing building heights, roofs, and facades.
composition.framing: District-scale view encompassing the full architectural layout with emphasis on 3D depth and textured surfaces.
composition.alignment: Perfectly register the 2D spatial positions between both input images for accurate texture-to-geometry mapping.

output_requirements.geometry: Exact 3D building volumes from image_2 with no geometric additions or modifications.
output_requirements.appearance: Photorealistic textures intelligently transferred from image_1 to create a believable, naturally-lit urban scene.
output_requirements.consistency: Seamless integration where the viewer cannot distinguish between mapped textures and generated facades.
output_requirements.cleanliness: No transient objects (vehicles, pedestrians), no road markings, no temporal artifacts from the satellite image.
